findings.text: the repaired sentence states the mechanism correctly but names the wrong file of the pair: "a week of dispatch decisions replays from docs/state/<project>/crew.json alone" - the row promotion lands is appended to the per-run file under docs/state/<project>/runs/ (ledger.run_path), and in a project with no prior aggregate no crew.json exists at all (the promoted sample tree I ran carried the row under docs/state/sample/runs/ and no crew.json), so a reader who follows section 9 to that path finds nothing for a freshly promoted run; crew.json is a separately-exported union member that ledger.load reads, not the destination ledger.build_record appends to.
